title: I have thoughts on the iPhone Air
excerpt: Hard to believe, but it’s been over 9 months since the current crop of iPhones came out, and I elected to grab the (apparently not super popular) iPhone Air, a new model of iPhone introduced for the first time. Rumor season for the new iPhones is in full swing, so it seemed like a good time to jot down my thoughts on the current model.
content_html:
July 7, 2026

Hard to believe, but it’s been over 9 months since the current crop of iPhones came out, and I elected to grab the (apparently not super popular) iPhone Air, a new model of iPhone introduced for the first time. Rumor season for the new iPhones is in full swing, so it seemed like a good time to jot down my thoughts on the current model.

Immediately, it’s really something to behold when you pick it up for the first time, it feels weirdly thin, pretty much everyone I’ve showed it to has been like “whoa”. You sacrifice a fair bit to get to that, from cameras to battery life, but I’ve always been a sucker for something novel, so when something as huge as the iPhone had a quirky new model I was really stoked to check it out.

Heck, part of my frame of mind was that this device is going to have some serious limitations, which will probably also apply to the rumored upcoming folding iPhone which I also really want to check out, so it’ll almost be a warmup round to get me in the right headspace for a folding iPhone. I think that makes sense?

Either way, over the last 9 months it’s been my primary phone day in and day out, and I wanted to jot down my thoughts on what it’s like to live with as someone who normally goes with the Pro phones, because there’s been some surprises.

The design

Picking up an iPhone Air for the first time is almost weird. Phones have had such a consistent slab design for so long that making it so, so dramatically thinner almost confuses your brain a little bit, like it’s an illusion or something. Forget putting a case on it, live with the danger.

My favorite example was handing my phone to an employee at a local store to show her a product I was looking for, I could see kind of a confused look when I handed it to her followed by a “your phone is so thin”, almost like she thought there was something wrong with it.

But, here’s my hot take. After the better part of a year it no longer feels thin, it just feels normal. Sure, when I pick up an older iPhone I’m lke “whoa this is so thick it feels like a relic”, but the Air doesn’t really feel noteworthy to me anymore. It’s like if you live in a cinnamon factory, I assume day one you’d be like “this is the best smelling place ever” but after a few months you’d go nose blind to it.

That gives me pause, because it kinda makes me wonder that if any reasonably thin phone just feels normal after awhile, is it worth a bunch of compromises just to get it even thinner, when even that thinness feels normal eventually? I kinda feel like I thought about the thinness of my Pro iPhone the same amount after 9 months as I do now with the Air (which is to say, not really at all) but had a less compromised phone to show for it.

And it’s weird, because with the old wedge-style MacBook Airs this feeling never went away for me, I loved those machines and every time I picked it up I kinda marveled, but that sensation kinda just went away with the iPhone Air, perhaps since I’m picking it up so much more than a laptop?

The screen

I’ve always been a normal-sized phone guy. The Plus/Max phones just feel unwieldy, but I do admit whenever I hold one I’m like “dang… maybe…”.

The iPhone Air is the perfect solution to this, its screen size sits right in the middle of the normal Pro and Pro Max sized phones, and is one of my favorite parts of the phone.

It’s large without feeling unwieldy (so awesome for games and videos), typing is a joy on the increased size, and it really makes me wish this size was the normal “small” Pro phone. Apple could then make the Pro Max phone 8" diagonal or something, I wanna test how far these Pro Max people will go.

As a bonus my iPhone Pro can’t fit one of those tiny Xteink readers on the back, but my Air can perfectly!

The cameras

Camera quality feels as good as ever, it’s apparently not as good a main sensor as the Pro iPhones but I can’t really tell. It still has that distinctly over-processed look plaguing modern smartphones, but using an app like Project Indigo or Halide really helps here as they have modes that heavily reduce this distinct “phone” look.

The real issue is that there’s only one sensor. I didn’t think I’d mind that much but unfortunately it turns out I do.

On one hand, the iPhone’s main sensor has worse minimum focus distance than some Android phones, which means if you’re trying to take a photo of a document or something it often ends up blurry, you have to pull back a little bit then crop in after the fact. Since the sensor is 48 MP there’s tons of room to crop in (and even a built in faux 2x lens option) but it’s just kind of an annoyance versus either having an improved minimum focus distance or auto-macro mode using the ultrawide lens like on other iPhones.

The ultrawide lens is not one I used a ton on previous iPhones, so outside of macro mode I don’t really miss it. I’m surprised though that I really miss the telephoto lens. There’s so many options where I want to see something that’s further away, like something when watching sports, or even a cool bird, and cropping in on the main sensor is such a far cry from a 5x telephoto lens.

I’m in the minority here but I really wish Apple went back to having the secondary lens on iPhones be telephoto instead of ultrawide, and it makes me sad that going to the future folding iPhone will likely mean I still don’t get a telephoto lens back.

Aside: camera plateaus have got out of control. This one rocks so badly if you try to interact with it while it’s lying down. I so prefer the Pixel style phones that have a consistent thickness across the full width of their camera plateau, because even though there’s a substantial plateau it doesn’t rock like a table with one short leg.

The speaker (yes, singular)

For the uninitiated, the iPhone Air has a single speaker up near the earpiece at the top of the phone. Pretty much every other modern iPhone (as far as I can remember) has one at the bottom as well, which means when watching video or something the audio doesn’t sound like it’s coming from one side of the phone.

I was tempted to make an analogy to watching a video with only one AirPod in, but it’s not quite that bad, you do sorta get used to it, but it being subpar never fully goes away.

What’s arguably worse though is with only one speaker the max volume is substantially lower, if you’re in an even remotely noisy environment (say, washing dishes) and you’re a little bit away from your iPhone good luck hearing things.

Battery life

Battery life confuses me. Coming from an iPhone 15 Pro which from everything I can tell was not revered for having the best battery life, I was pleasantly surprised with the iPhone Air’s battery life, it easily got me through a day where it sometimes felt the 15 Pro wouldn’t. This felt like an impossible feat given the thinness of the device, but improvements in electronics efficiency is remarkable.

As time went on though, I started to be less impressed. Entering the spring season I started to notice getting the 20% battery notification a lot more often, and now in the summer it’s only gotten worse where it’s virtually every day. According to battery stats I’m still at 96% health.

Is this an iOS regression that’s causing more battery usage? Am I just going out and on cellular more now that it’s gotten warmer? I honestly have no idea, but either way I wouldn’t call this phone a battery champion. I really long for a day where battery life is an afterthought in phones, some of the Silicon Carbide battery stuff seems really interesting here, so fingers crossed there’s some cool battery tech in the folding iPhone.

Overall thoughts

Ultimately, I love this phone, but I don’t think I’d recommend it to most people. Honestly, I’m not even sure I’d get it again over a Pro iPhone when it really comes down to it.

If a fascinatingly cool design matters to you above all else, you should go for it. That sounds superficial, but I don’t think it is. Lots of people appreciate wearing a beautifully crafted mechanical watch over a $10 digital watch that is empirically more accurate and less fussy, there’s something just delightful about impressively crafted objects. I feel like we’re gonna be looking back at this phone even in 5 years remarking at its form factor versus 2031 phones, and there’s really something to say for a phone design being that bold.

But it really does go back to that original MacBook Air that Steve Jobs pulled out of the manilla envelope. Absolutely amazing piece of engineering, as if something from the future came back proudly to show us what’s to come, but also something with enough compromises that your average person probably shouldn’t brave these waters. (Does anyone remember CoolBook?)

sentences.zh: 作为奖励，我的 iPhone Pro 背面无法安装那些小型 Xteink 读卡器，但我的 Air 却可以！

blocks.html_en: The cameras

sentences.en: The cameras
sentences.zh: 相机

blocks.html_en: Camera quality feels as good as ever, it’s apparently not as good a main sensor as the Pro iPhones but I can’t really tell. It still has that distinctly over-processed look plaguing modern smartphones, but using an app like Project Indigo or Halide really helps here as they have modes that heavily reduce this distinct “phone” look.

sentences.en: Camera quality feels as good as ever, it’s apparently not as good a main sensor as the Pro iPhones but I can’t really tell.
sentences.zh: 相机质量感觉一如既往的好，它的主传感器显然不如 iPhone Pro，但我真的不能说。

sentences.en: It still has that distinctly over-processed look plaguing modern smartphones, but using an app like Project Indigo or Halide really helps here as they have modes that heavily reduce this distinct “phone” look.
sentences.zh: 它仍然具有困扰现代智能手机的明显过度处理的外观，但使用 Project Indigo 或 Halide 等应用程序确实有帮助，因为它们的模式可以大大减少这种独特的“手机”外观。

blocks.html_en: The real issue is that there’s only one sensor. I didn’t think I’d mind that much but unfortunately it turns out I do.

sentences.en: The real issue is that there’s only one sensor.
sentences.zh: 真正的问题是只有一个传感器。

sentences.en: I didn’t think I’d mind that much but unfortunately it turns out I do.
sentences.zh: 我以为我不会那么介意，但不幸的是事实证明我很介意。

blocks.html_en: On one hand, the iPhone’s main sensor has worse minimum focus distance than some Android phones, which means if you’re trying to take a photo of a document or something it often ends up blurry, you have to pull back a little bit then crop in after the fact. Since the sensor is 48 MP there’s tons of room to crop in (and even a built in faux 2x lens option) but it’s just kind of an annoyance versus either having an improved minimum focus distance or auto-macro mode using the ultrawide lens like on other iPhones.

sentences.en: On one hand, the iPhone’s main sensor has worse minimum focus distance than some Android phones, which means if you’re trying to take a photo of a document or something it often ends up blurry, you have to pull back a little bit then crop in after the fact.
sentences.zh: 一方面，iPhone 的主传感器的最小焦距比某些 Android 手机要差，这意味着如果您尝试拍摄文档或其他通常会变得模糊的照片，则必须向后拉一点，然后再进行裁剪。

sentences.en: Since the sensor is 48 MP there’s tons of room to crop in (and even a built in faux 2x lens option) but it’s just kind of an annoyance versus either having an improved minimum focus distance or auto-macro mode using the ultrawide lens like on other iPhones.
sentences.zh: 由于传感器为 48 MP，因此有大量的裁剪空间（甚至还有内置的人造 2x 镜头选项），但与其他 iPhone 上使用超广角镜头的改进的最小焦距或自动微距模式相比，这只是一种烦恼。

blocks.html_en: The ultrawide lens is not one I used a ton on previous iPhones, so outside of macro mode I don’t really miss it. I’m surprised though that I really miss the telephoto lens. There’s so many options where I want to see something that’s further away, like something when watching sports, or even a cool bird, and cropping in on the main sensor is such a far cry from a 5x telephoto lens.

sentences.en: The ultrawide lens is not one I used a ton on previous iPhones, so outside of macro mode I don’t really miss it.
sentences.zh: 我在之前的 iPhone 上并没有经常使用超广角镜头，所以除了微距模式之外，我并没有真正怀念它。

sentences.en: I’m surprised though that I really miss the telephoto lens.
sentences.zh: 但令我惊讶的是，我真的很怀念长焦镜头。

sentences.en: There’s so many options where I want to see something that’s further away, like something when watching sports, or even a cool bird, and cropping in on the main sensor is such a far cry from a 5x telephoto lens.
sentences.zh: 有很多选择让我想看到更远的东西，比如观看体育比赛时的东西，甚至是一只很酷的鸟，而在主传感器上进行裁剪与 5 倍长焦镜头相差甚远。

blocks.html_en: I’m in the minority here but I really wish Apple went back to having the secondary lens on iPhones be telephoto instead of ultrawide, and it makes me sad that going to the future folding iPhone will likely mean I still don’t get a telephoto lens back.

sentences.en: I’m in the minority here but I really wish Apple went back to having the secondary lens on iPhones be telephoto instead of ultrawide, and it makes me sad that going to the future folding iPhone will likely mean I still don’t get a telephoto lens back.
sentences.zh: 我属于少数派，但我真的希望苹果能够重新将 iPhone 上的副镜头设置为长焦镜头而不是超广角镜头，这让我感到难过，因为未来的折叠 iPhone 可能意味着我仍然无法恢复长焦镜头。

blocks.html_en: Aside: camera plateaus have got out of control. This one rocks so badly if you try to interact with it while it’s lying down. I so prefer the Pixel style phones that have a consistent thickness across the full width of their camera plateau, because even though there’s a substantial plateau it doesn’t rock like a table with one short leg.

sentences.en: Aside: camera plateaus have got out of control.
sentences.zh: 旁白：相机平台已经失控。

sentences.en: This one rocks so badly if you try to interact with it while it’s lying down.
sentences.zh: 如果你试图在它躺着时与它互动，它会摇得很厉害。

sentences.en: I so prefer the Pixel style phones that have a consistent thickness across the full width of their camera plateau, because even though there’s a substantial plateau it doesn’t rock like a table with one short leg.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢 Pixel 风格的手机，它们在相机平台的整个宽度上具有一致的厚度，因为即使有一个很大的平台，它也不会像一张短腿的桌子那样摇晃。

blocks.html_en: The speaker (yes, singular)

sentences.en: The speaker (yes, singular)
sentences.zh: 说话者（是的，单数）

blocks.html_en: For the uninitiated, the iPhone Air has a single speaker up near the earpiece at the top of the phone. Pretty much every other modern iPhone (as far as I can remember) has one at the bottom as well, which means when watching video or something the audio doesn’t sound like it’s coming from one side of the phone.

sentences.en: For the uninitiated, the iPhone Air has a single speaker up near the earpiece at the top of the phone.
sentences.zh: 对于不熟悉的人来说，iPhone Air 在手机顶部的听筒附近有一个扬声器。

sentences.en: Pretty much every other modern iPhone (as far as I can remember) has one at the bottom as well, which means when watching video or something the audio doesn’t sound like it’s coming from one side of the phone.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有其他现代 iPhone（据我记得）底部也有一个，这意味着在观看视频或其他内容时，音频听起来不像是来自手机的一侧。

blocks.html_en: I was tempted to make an analogy to watching a video with only one AirPod in, but it’s not quite that bad, you do sorta get used to it, but it being subpar never fully goes away.

sentences.en: I was tempted to make an analogy to watching a video with only one AirPod in, but it’s not quite that bad, you do sorta get used to it, but it being subpar never fully goes away.
sentences.zh: 我很想用只戴一个 AirPod 来观看视频进行类比，但这并没有那么糟糕，你确实有点习惯了，但低于标准的情况永远不会完全消失。

blocks.html_en: What’s arguably worse though is with only one speaker the max volume is substantially lower, if you’re in an even remotely noisy environment (say, washing dishes) and you’re a little bit away from your iPhone good luck hearing things.

sentences.en: What’s arguably worse though is with only one speaker the max volume is substantially lower, if you’re in an even remotely noisy environment (say, washing dishes) and you’re a little bit away from your iPhone good luck hearing things.
sentences.zh: 但可以说更糟糕的是，只有一个扬声器时，最大音量会大大降低，如果您处于一个甚至远程嘈杂的环境中（例如洗碗），并且您距离 iPhone 有点远，祝您好运，听清声音。

blocks.html_en: Battery life

sentences.en: Battery life
sentences.zh: 电池寿命

blocks.html_en: Battery life confuses me. Coming from an iPhone 15 Pro which from everything I can tell was not revered for having the best battery life, I was pleasantly surprised with the iPhone Air’s battery life, it easily got me through a day where it sometimes felt the 15 Pro wouldn’t. This felt like an impossible feat given the thinness of the device, but improvements in electronics efficiency is remarkable.

sentences.en: Battery life confuses me.
sentences.zh: 电池寿命让我困惑。

sentences.en: Coming from an iPhone 15 Pro which from everything I can tell was not revered for having the best battery life, I was pleasantly surprised with the iPhone Air’s battery life, it easily got me through a day where it sometimes felt the 15 Pro wouldn’t.
sentences.zh: 从我所知道的一切来看，iPhone 15 Pro 并不因其拥有最佳的电池续航时间而受到推崇，我对 iPhone Air 的电池续航时间感到惊喜，它轻松地让我度过了有时感觉 15 Pro 无法做到的一天。

sentences.en: This felt like an impossible feat given the thinness of the device, but improvements in electronics efficiency is remarkable.
sentences.zh: 考虑到该设备的厚度，这感觉像是一项不可能的壮举，但电子效率的提高是显着的。

blocks.html_en: As time went on though, I started to be less impressed. Entering the spring season I started to notice getting the 20% battery notification a lot more often, and now in the summer it’s only gotten worse where it’s virtually every day. According to battery stats I’m still at 96% health.

sentences.en: As time went on though, I started to be less impressed.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，我开始不再那么印象深刻。

sentences.en: Entering the spring season I started to notice getting the 20% battery notification a lot more often, and now in the summer it’s only gotten worse where it’s virtually every day.
sentences.zh: 进入春季，我开始注意到越来越频繁地收到 20% 电量通知，而现在到了夏天，这种情况几乎每天都变得更糟。

sentences.en: According to battery stats I’m still at 96% health.
sentences.zh: 根据电池统计数据，我的健康状况仍为 96%。

blocks.html_en: Is this an iOS regression that’s causing more battery usage? Am I just going out and on cellular more now that it’s gotten warmer? I honestly have no idea, but either way I wouldn’t call this phone a battery champion. I really long for a day where battery life is an afterthought in phones, some of the Silicon Carbide battery stuff seems really interesting here, so fingers crossed there’s some cool battery tech in the folding iPhone.

sentences.en: Is this an iOS regression that’s causing more battery usage?
sentences.zh: 这是 iOS 的回归导致电池使用量增加吗？

sentences.en: Am I just going out and on cellular more now that it’s gotten warmer?
sentences.zh: 现在天气变暖了，我是否只是出去更多地使用手机？

sentences.en: I honestly have no idea, but either way I wouldn’t call this phone a battery champion.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不知道，但无论如何，我不会称这款手机为电池冠军。

sentences.en: I really long for a day where battery life is an afterthought in phones, some of the Silicon Carbide battery stuff seems really interesting here, so fingers crossed there’s some cool battery tech in the folding iPhone.
sentences.zh: 我真的很渴望有一天电池寿命成为手机中的事后考虑，一些碳化硅电池看起来真的很有趣，所以祈祷折叠 iPhone 中有一些很酷的电池技术。

blocks.html_en: Overall thoughts

sentences.en: Overall thoughts
sentences.zh: 总体想法

blocks.html_en: Ultimately, I love this phone, but I don’t think I’d recommend it to most people. Honestly, I’m not even sure I’d get it again over a Pro iPhone when it really comes down to it.

sentences.en: Ultimately, I love this phone, but I don’t think I’d recommend it to most people.
sentences.zh: 最终，我喜欢这款手机，但我认为我不会向大多数人推荐它。

sentences.en: Honestly, I’m not even sure I’d get it again over a Pro iPhone when it really comes down to it.
sentences.zh: 老实说，当真正到了关键时刻，我什至不确定自己是否会再次选择 iPhone Pro。

blocks.html_en: If a fascinatingly cool design matters to you above all else, you should go for it. That sounds superficial, but I don’t think it is. Lots of people appreciate wearing a beautifully crafted mechanical watch over a $10 digital watch that is empirically more accurate and less fussy, there’s something just delightful about impressively crafted objects. I feel like we’re gonna be looking back at this phone even in 5 years remarking at its form factor versus 2031 phones, and there’s really something to say for a phone design being that bold.

sentences.en: If a fascinatingly cool design matters to you above all else, you should go for it.
sentences.zh: 如果一个令人着迷的酷设计对您来说比其他一切都重要，那么您应该接受它。

sentences.en: That sounds superficial, but I don’t think it is.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很肤浅，但我认为并非如此。

sentences.en: Lots of people appreciate wearing a beautifully crafted mechanical watch over a $10 digital watch that is empirically more accurate and less fussy, there’s something just delightful about impressively crafted objects.
sentences.zh: 很多人更喜欢佩戴做工精美的机械手表，而不是价值 10 美元的数字手表，后者在经验上更准确且不那么挑剔，令人印象深刻的做工令人愉悦。

sentences.en: I feel like we’re gonna be looking back at this phone even in 5 years remarking at its form factor versus 2031 phones, and there’s really something to say for a phone design being that bold.
sentences.zh: 我觉得即使在 5 年后我们也会回顾这款手机，对比它的外形尺寸与 2031 年的手机，如此大胆的手机设计确实有话可说。

blocks.html_en: But it really does go back to that original MacBook Air that Steve Jobs pulled out of the manilla envelope. Absolutely amazing piece of engineering, as if something from the future came back proudly to show us what’s to come, but also something with enough compromises that your average person probably shouldn’t brave these waters. (Does anyone remember CoolBook?)

sentences.en: But it really does go back to that original MacBook Air that Steve Jobs pulled out of the manilla envelope.
sentences.zh: 但它确实可以追溯到史蒂夫·乔布斯从马尼拉信封中取出的最初的 MacBook Air。

sentences.en: Absolutely amazing piece of engineering, as if something from the future came back proudly to show us what’s to come, but also something with enough compromises that your average person probably shouldn’t brave these waters.
sentences.zh: 绝对令人惊叹的工程作品，就好像来自未来的东西自豪地回来向我们展示即将发生的事情，但也有足够的妥协，以至于普通人可能不应该勇敢地冒险这些水域。

sentences.en: (Does anyone remember CoolBook?)
sentences.zh: （还有人记得CoolBook吗？）

content_html_zh:
July 7, 2026

难以置信，距离当前一批 iPhone 上市已经过去 9 个多月了，我选择购买 iPhone Air（显然不是很受欢迎），这是首次推出的新 iPhone 型号。 新 iPhone 的谣言季节正如火如荼地进行，所以现在似乎是记下我对当前型号的想法的好时机。

当你第一次拿起它时，它真的很值得一看，它感觉很奇怪，很薄，几乎每个我向我展示过它的人都会说“哇”。 为了达到这个目的，你需要牺牲一些东西，从相机到电池寿命，但我一直很喜欢新奇的东西，所以当像 iPhone 这样巨大的东西有一个古怪的新型号时，我真的很兴奋去看看它。

哎呀，我的部分想法是，这款设备将会有一些严重的局限性，这可能也适用于传闻中即将推出的折叠 iPhone，我也很想看看，所以这几乎是一个热身回合，让我为折叠 iPhone 做好准备。 我认为这有道理吗？

不管怎样，在过去的 9 个月里，它日复一日地成为我的主要手机，我想记下我作为一个通常使用 Pro 手机的人的生活感受，因为有一些惊喜。

设计

第一次拿起 iPhone Air 几乎感觉很奇怪。 长期以来，手机一直采用一致的平板设计，以至于它变得如此薄，几乎让你的大脑有点困惑，就像这是一种错觉或什么的。 忘记把它放在上面，与危险一起生活。

我最喜欢的例子是将我的手机交给当地一家商店的员工，向她展示我正在寻找的产品，当我把手机递给她时，我可以看到一种困惑的表情，然后是“你的手机太薄了”，几乎就像她认为它有问题一样。

但是，这是我的热门观点。 一年后的大部分时间，它不再感觉瘦弱，只是感觉正常。 当然，当我拿起一部旧款 iPhone 时，我会感叹“哇，这太厚了，感觉就像是一件古董”，但 Air 对我来说已经不再那么值得注意了。 就像如果你住在肉桂工厂里，我想第一天你会说“这是有史以来闻起来最好闻的地方”，但几个月后你就会对它视而不见。

这让我犹豫了，因为这让我有点想知道，如果任何相当薄的手机在一段时间后感觉很正常，是否值得为了让它变得更薄而做出一系列妥协，即使这种薄度最终感觉很正常？ 我觉得 9 个月后，我对 iPhone Pro 的厚度的看法与现在对 Air 的看法是一样的（也就是说，根本不是），但我有一款不那么妥协的手机来证明这一点。

这很奇怪，因为对于旧的楔形 MacBook Air，这种感觉对我来说从未消失，我喜欢这些机器，每次拿起它时我都会感到惊讶，但这种感觉在 iPhone Air 上就消失了，也许是因为我拿起它不仅仅是一台笔记本电脑？

屏幕

我一直是一个普通尺寸的手机用户。 Plus/Max 手机感觉很笨重，但我承认，每当我拿着手机时，我都会想“该死……” 或许…”。

iPhone Air 是这个问题的完美解决方案，它的屏幕尺寸正好位于普通 Pro 和 Pro Max 尺寸手机的中间，是我最喜欢的手机部分之一。

它很大，但不会感觉笨重（对于游戏和视频来说太棒了），增加的尺寸打字是一种乐趣，这真的让我希望这个尺寸是正常的“小”Pro手机。 然后苹果可以把 Pro Max 手机做成 8 英寸对角线什么的，我想测试一下这些 Pro Max 的人能走多远。

作为奖励，我的 iPhone Pro 背面无法安装那些小型 Xteink 读卡器，但我的 Air 却可以！

相机

相机质量感觉一如既往的好，它的主传感器显然不如 iPhone Pro，但我真的不能说。 它仍然具有困扰现代智能手机的明显过度处理的外观，但使用 Project Indigo 或 Halide 等应用程序确实有帮助，因为它们的模式可以大大减少这种独特的“手机”外观。

真正的问题是只有一个传感器。 我以为我不会那么介意，但不幸的是事实证明我很介意。

一方面，iPhone 的主传感器的最小焦距比某些 Android 手机要差，这意味着如果您尝试拍摄文档或其他通常会变得模糊的照片，则必须向后拉一点，然后再进行裁剪。 由于传感器为 48 MP，因此有大量的裁剪空间（甚至还有内置的人造 2x 镜头选项），但与其他 iPhone 上使用超广角镜头的改进的最小焦距或自动微距模式相比，这只是一种烦恼。

我在之前的 iPhone 上并没有经常使用超广角镜头，所以除了微距模式之外，我并没有真正怀念它。 但令我惊讶的是，我真的很怀念长焦镜头。 有很多选择让我想看到更远的东西，比如观看体育比赛时的东西，甚至是一只很酷的鸟，而在主传感器上进行裁剪与 5 倍长焦镜头相差甚远。

我属于少数派，但我真的希望苹果能够重新将 iPhone 上的副镜头设置为长焦镜头而不是超广角镜头，这让我感到难过，因为未来的折叠 iPhone 可能意味着我仍然无法恢复长焦镜头。

旁白：相机平台已经失控。 如果你试图在它躺着时与它互动，它会摇得很厉害。 我非常喜欢 Pixel 风格的手机，它们在相机平台的整个宽度上具有一致的厚度，因为即使有一个很大的平台，它也不会像一张短腿的桌子那样摇晃。

说话者（是的，单数）

对于不熟悉的人来说，iPhone Air 在手机顶部的听筒附近有一个扬声器。 几乎所有其他现代 iPhone（据我记得）底部也有一个，这意味着在观看视频或其他内容时，音频听起来不像是来自手机的一侧。

我很想用只戴一个 AirPod 来观看视频进行类比，但这并没有那么糟糕，你确实有点习惯了，但低于标准的情况永远不会完全消失。

但可以说更糟糕的是，只有一个扬声器时，最大音量会大大降低，如果您处于一个甚至远程嘈杂的环境中（例如洗碗），并且您距离 iPhone 有点远，祝您好运，听清声音。

电池寿命

电池寿命让我困惑。 从我所知道的一切来看，iPhone 15 Pro 并不因其拥有最佳的电池续航时间而受到推崇，我对 iPhone Air 的电池续航时间感到惊喜，它轻松地让我度过了有时感觉 15 Pro 无法做到的一天。 考虑到该设备的厚度，这感觉像是一项不可能的壮举，但电子效率的提高是显着的。

但随着时间的推移，我开始不再那么印象深刻。 进入春季，我开始注意到越来越频繁地收到 20% 电量通知，而现在到了夏天，这种情况几乎每天都变得更糟。 根据电池统计数据，我的健康状况仍为 96%。

这是 iOS 的回归导致电池使用量增加吗？ 现在天气变暖了，我是否只是出去更多地使用手机？ 老实说，我不知道，但无论如何，我不会称这款手机为电池冠军。 我真的很渴望有一天电池寿命成为手机中的事后考虑，一些碳化硅电池看起来真的很有趣，所以祈祷折叠 iPhone 中有一些很酷的电池技术。

总体想法

最终，我喜欢这款手机，但我认为我不会向大多数人推荐它。 老实说，当真正到了关键时刻，我什至不确定自己是否会再次选择 iPhone Pro。

如果一个令人着迷的酷设计对您来说比其他一切都重要，那么您应该接受它。 这听起来很肤浅，但我认为并非如此。 很多人更喜欢佩戴做工精美的机械手表，而不是价值 10 美元的数字手表，后者在经验上更准确且不那么挑剔，令人印象深刻的做工令人愉悦。 我觉得即使在 5 年后我们也会回顾这款手机，对比它的外形尺寸与 2031 年的手机，如此大胆的手机设计确实有话可说。

但它确实可以追溯到史蒂夫·乔布斯从马尼拉信封中取出的最初的 MacBook Air。 绝对令人惊叹的工程作品，就好像来自未来的东西自豪地回来向我们展示即将发生的事情，但也有足够的妥协，以至于普通人可能不应该勇敢地冒险这些水域。 （还有人记得CoolBook吗？）
